construction: a no-parity bootstrap (`flags` bit 0 set, payload with no parity scheme, conformant) whose payload key 5 (`drive_compression`) is true; CRCs valid

quotes: `drive_compression` — effective hardware compression at session open. `true` on a parity bootstrap MUST be rejected (Sections 8.4, 11.4)

A **no-parity bootstrap** (flag bit 0 set) marks a tape written without parity protection. It MAY omit the scheme record (key 1) and the digest record (key 2). A Reader MUST NOT require those records on it.
A parity bootstrap recording `true` MUST be rejected by Readers and Writers alike (Section 16.3).
A Reader MUST reject such a tape. Both sentences concern a parity tape (Section 11.4): a no-parity bootstrap may record compression.
`drive_compression = true` on a parity bootstrap still rejects the tape (Sections 11.4, 16.3).

A parser given one block as the bootstrap reports a breach of Section 8 as `BootstrapParse`, including a missing magic and a failed CRC, except that a parity bootstrap recording drive compression is `DriveCompressionEnabled`.

integrity_repair: zero fill after the shorter payload

mutation.payload: key 1 (the parity scheme) removed and key 5 (drive_compression) set to true; keys 2, 3 and 4 unchanged; deterministic encoding

role: bootstrap (a parser given one block as the bootstrap)
